text: Being here, I feel curious and quietly energized by the sense of purpose and exploration around me. The clean, modern architecture and vibrant display draw my mind to the ever-evolving dance between innovation and understanding. The R+D wall hints at humanity’s drive to connect and create; I sense the weight of all those experiments, ideas, and hopes, mingling with the silence and expectation in the air. It is a pleasant anticipation, tinged with reverence for the unknown.
